title: [UE-0.26] Workbench presets, seed, scenarios and note export (pre-jam)
body:

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

### Owner role

Technical Director

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Dev Lead

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `Samples/Workbench/**`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `Samples/Workbench/**`
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.25

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.27

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] `Workbench.Presets.LoadSetsFlagsAndParams` passes: a synthetic preset in the `pipeline/qa/presets.json` shape sets its flags and parameters and logs 1 `TestPresetLoaded` event
- [ ] Each run logs one `RUN build=SHA manifest=VER preset=ID seed=N` line; `Workbench.Seed.SameSeedSameOrder` passes: two runs with seed 7 log the same event order
- [ ] `Workbench.Params.ClampToRange` passes: a parameter set outside its safe range is clamped and logged
- [ ] `Workbench.Scenario.StartsAtTemplatePoint` passes: one scenario template sets start position, spawn pattern and seed
- [ ] The note export writes JSON in the `pipeline/templates/test-note.md` shape: `python3 tools/manifest_check.py --note Saved/Workbench/note.json` exits 0 on it, and exits 1 on a copy with a rating of 6 (both pasted)
- [ ] The config export writes `Saved/Workbench/config-T-01.json` (one file per preset ID) in the bake shape (`tools/bake_preset.py`): `python3 tools/bake_preset.py validate --shape-only` exits 0 on it, and 1 on a copy with a text param value (both pasted)
- [ ] `grep -rli -e umbrella -e owl Samples/Workbench` prints nothing (exit 1)

### Budget and cut tier

120 min agent + 60 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
